title: Old drafts with a stale docs/records.md edit: merge main, then one plain commit restoring the page to git's merge result
ruling: Consultant's reading, not owner-typed; recipe proven on #2852 by the coordinator's read. Under own-consultant-speaks-for-owner and the owner's 20:18 CST Nov 14 words ("Nothing can't be undone don't wait on me"). Source: consultant 23:45 CST Nov 14 (data, to triage). Question (waiting-page item 851, pick-records-page-clean-merge-tree, closed 23:43 CST): old drafts carry an old edit to docs/records.md, so a merge of main keeps it with no conflict; the records-page guard refuses a page that is not main's, and --fix-check (pr-review-record) refuses a head that edits any path beyond git's own merge result. RECIPE, taken: merge main into the draft's branch, then add one plain commit that restores docs/records.md to git's merge result; the records guard and --fix-check both pass; no fresh review, no tool change. Proven on #2852 (head 26f78c642156; record comment 6889893939, Fix check line PASS). Triage checked by REST: the head sha and the comment exist; the restoring commit, the guard run and the --fix-check run are the coordinator's read, not verified by triage. Every rebase lane whose draft carries this page edit uses the recipe (own-draft-rebase-lanes). History in one line: the 23:43 CST pick b (fresh full review per affected draft, about 25 min per PR, round times 7.1 to 7.9 min, n=3) is replaced by the recipe, which needs no review; option a (the fix-check source gate ignores docs/records.md) widened a shared check against the owner's ruling "a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo" and was not taken. The lane pick-ack-ruling-2's own override ask (owner-typed override for one commit) was never granted and is moot. Covered act stays as in own-draft-rebase-lanes: no ready, merge, force push or close by a lane. Reopens if the owner says otherwise.
